package.name: kontrolem_estimation
package.description: ROS-free floating-base state estimator (contact-aided, InEKF-ready). A BaseEstimator fuses an IMU with leg odometry (stance-foot kinematics) to estimate the SE_2(3) base state (R, v, p) — the base pose/twist a real robot has no ground-truth oracle for. Eigen + kontrolem_model only; no ROS.
